title: Castlevania: Aria of Sorrow - Whip, Cross, & Justice!! ✝️ ~ Don't Wait Until Night x Heart of Fire (Remix II)
description:
❝ 𝔑𝔬𝔱𝔥𝔦𝔫𝔤 𝔶𝔬𝔲 𝔰𝔞𝔶 𝔴𝔦𝔩𝔩 𝔰𝔱𝔬𝔭 𝔪𝔢! 𝔓𝔯𝔢𝔭𝔞𝔯𝔢 𝔱𝔬 𝔡𝔦𝔢! ❞
ㅤ- Julius Belmont, Castlevania: Aria of Sorrow (2003)



Did a second arrangement of Don't Wait Until Night from Castlevania: Aria of Sorrow (originally from Haunted Castle). Celebrating 6 years of SNES-mix uploads (5 years on YouTube specifically) with arranging the song that would be my first ever mix uploaded onto YouTube. I thought it'd be fun to go back and do another "re-remix" of an old mix of mine, though this time, I'd base it off both the Haunted Castle & Aria of Sorrow versions rather than basing it off just Haunted Castle's version.

I have plans to do more "re-remixes" of some very old tracks in the future, and this is one of my first ones I'll be doing.

Important:
ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," P-Switch, Yoshi SFX, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. D Minor (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. E Minor (Remix I Pitch)
ㅤ3. C Minor (NES Pitch)
ㅤ4. D# Minor (Whip Rush!! Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Original Echo Delay, but sacrifices SMW-Compatibility (OG Echo)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. Decreased Echo Delay, but disables outro (DISABLES Outro)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ3. Drastically Decreased Echo Delay (LOWER Echo)
